auditStatus: Historical baseline 387 scoped declarations plus later additions; current 560 primary rows. The #369 known-omission repair adds 54 Rust and 6 UI source-reviewed records with explicit individual limitations and historical execution boundaries. This is not whole-repository semantic compliance, fresh execution or closure of existing follow-ups.

ui_fixture.scope: Deterministic fixture-backed XCUITest journeys. Scenario launch arguments establish in-app fixture state; the UI is driven through XCUIApplication.

rules.1: Applicable: tests assert visible labels, values, navigation outcomes, and action availability; individual method body is authoritative.
rules.2: Applicable: waits are bounded XCTest existence/property expectations; selected scroll loops end with a separately asserted condition. Fixed delays used only where elapsed time itself is part of fixture contract; see follow-ups.
rules.3: N/A for exact position assertions in this family; playback tests assert state/controls, not exact playback position. Live timed audio tests use another profile.
rules.4: Applicable where async; async UI tests await their completion and XCTest waits bound UI transitions. UI-test process owns app lifecycle.
rules.5: Applicable: each journey launches with explicit fixture arguments; tests do not use prior test order as setup. Persistent relaunch state is scoped to a named relaunch scenario.
rules.6: Applicable: deterministic fixture, no network/server contract unless explicitly enabled by a separate live profile.
rules.7: Applicable: no retry-to-green policy was found in inspected UI bodies; test defects remain distinct from simulator infrastructure failures.
rules.8: Partial: XCTest assertions retain named test/action context and selected screenshot attachments; ordinary assertions do not attach full accessibility dumps on every failure.
rules.9: Focused Xcode repetitions executed; see docs/release-evidence/test-reliability-audit.md for exact selected identities, failures, fixes and owning-suite results. Unselected opt-in configurations remain unrun; no alternate order/seed is claimed.

live_swift.scope: XCTest integration with disposable Audiobookshelf/telemetry services, actual HTTPS or local HTTP Collector boundary, credentials supplied by scripts, and root/prefix variants where the contract applies.

rules.1: Applicable: request/response, persistence, token validity, and recovery assertions are in each body.
rules.2: Applicable: async APIs are awaited; recovery helpers use explicit bounded polling/flush or framework operation completion. Timing sleep noted separately where used to cross token refresh window.
rules.3: N/A: these tests do not assert audible playback position; playback-session tests assert routes/contracts.
rules.4: Applicable: XCTest async entry points await requests; telemetry pipelines are shut down in teardown blocks or explicitly before replacement.
rules.5: Applicable: accounts/models/stores are created per test; disposable server seeded by live script. Cleanup is test-owned.
rules.6: Applicable: true server/HTTPS/Collector integration. `scripts/test-live.sh`/telemetry harness provide prerequisites; missing environment throws XCTSkip, which is an intentional opt-in condition.
rules.7: Applicable: no blind retries are used for contract failures; service startup/availability is an infrastructure prerequisite.
rules.8: Partial: assertion location and XCTest result bundle identify failures; no universal request diagnostics attachment was observed.
rules.9: Six disposable telemetry cases passed twice with fresh services; exact identities and revisions are in docs/release-evidence/test-reliability-audit.md. Audiobookshelf/live-app and device configurations remain unrun.

python_deterministic.scope: Python unittest for scanner/redactor and artifact report functions using temporary directories and in-memory byte/string fixtures.

rules.1: Applicable: asserts exact match, redaction, classification, and rejection outputs.
rules.2: N/A: synchronous pure-function tests with no asynchronous work.
rules.3: N/A: no playback behavior.
rules.4: N/A: no async operations or observers.
rules.5: Applicable: temporary directories are per test and registered cleanup removes artifacts.
rules.6: Applicable: deterministic unit tests; no external service or personal state.
rules.7: Applicable: no retry or tolerance widening.
rules.8: Applicable: unittest case and subTest preserve case context; fixtures contain synthetic secrets only.
rules.9: All 32 Python cases passed in two executions; individual outputs retained under .build/test-audit-evidence/. No alternate seed/order is claimed.

rust_deterministic.scope: Rust unit/integration tests in `scripts/tests` and `bleat-api/src` that use typed inputs, temporary directories, and fixture data.

rules.1: Applicable: assertions inspect typed results, errors, bytes, or output values.
rules.2: Applicable where Tokio async APIs are involved; otherwise N/A for synchronous tests. Async work is awaited in the body.
rules.3: N/A: no playback behavior.
rules.4: Applicable to Tokio tests: requests/tasks are awaited; local process timeout cases have bounded polling and process kill/reap.
rules.5: Applicable: temporary files/dirs or uniquely seeded values isolate state; no test-order setup dependency observed in inspected body patterns.
rules.6: Applicable: unit tests are deterministic; HTTP process/database integration is separately profiled.
rules.7: Applicable: no retry-to-green loops used as a pass condition; retry algorithm tests model policy directly.
rules.8: Applicable: assertion messages and named Rust test identity report failing values; privacy-sensitive fixtures are synthetic.
rules.9: API unit suite (75) and scripts App Store Connect target (5) passed repeatedly. Other scripts cases have discovery/source review only. Exact gates and revisions are in docs/release-evidence/test-reliability-audit.md.

rust_service_integration.scope: Rust integration tests requiring disposable PostgreSQL, HTTP router/process, or service state. `TestSupport` provides per-test PostgreSQL startup and migrations.

rules.1: Applicable: HTTP status, decoded values, persistence state, typed outcomes, or process exit are asserted.
rules.2: Applicable: Tokio operations are awaited; process lifecycle has a 10-second timeout, kill and reap. Database container startup readiness is delegated to TestPostgres.
rules.3: N/A: no playback behavior.
rules.4: Applicable: async requests/tasks are awaited; child processes are bounded and reaped.
rules.5: Applicable: each test starts its own Postgres fixture and generated IDs/temp keys are unique; cleanup is fixture-owned.
rules.6: Applicable: real PostgreSQL and/or process/router integration; Docker is required. No claim of external Apple attestation/device coverage.
rules.7: Applicable: service failure is asserted as the contract; Docker/environment failures are infrastructure.
rules.8: Applicable: test names and assertion messages carry action/context; privacy-sensitive errors are checked after redaction in process test.
rules.9: All API integration cases passed in both telemetry gates; current final-source HTTP target passed 12/12 after fixture revert. See docs/release-evidence/test-reliability-audit.md for revisions and individual outcomes.

rules.1: Applicable: value, thrown error, data round trip and actor counter results are asserted.
rules.2: Applicable for async methods; Swift Testing awaits async test bodies and actor operations. No guessed sleeps/yields.
rules.3: N/A: no playback.
rules.4: Applicable: async operations are awaited; no detached work/observer cleanup.
rules.5: Applicable: each SwiftData test creates an in-memory ModelContainer and local account IDs.
rules.6: Applicable: deterministic prototype fixture; intentional disabled case is explicitly annotated and should remain reported as skipped.
rules.7: Applicable: no retry/tolerance behavior.
rules.8: Applicable: named Swift Testing expectations and failures; no artifact retention needed for deterministic host assertions.
rules.9: Not executed in this audit; no repetition claim.

live_cover_process.scope: One actual live UI cover-edit/process-relaunch check against a disposable seeded Audiobookshelf server; no in-app fixture service.

rules.1: Separate served JPEG pixels and rendered card pixels establish actual replacement; actual process notRunning and retained installation/login establish restart context.
rules.2: Await async HTTP requests; asserted UI readiness and bounded30second single-screenshot pixel predicate; no arbitrary sleeps.
rules.3: Exact red/blue fractions, strictly increasing server timestamp and typed app state; no playback clock assertion.
rules.4: Owned test-server account/media and dedicated Simulator; deferred app termination, harness teardown separately verified.
rules.5: Explicit fresh owned installation before invocation, same installation/cache retained across its internal process restart. Synthetic live configuration is required.
rules.6: Real pinned server and HTTPS app path; direct loopback test control uses HTTP; no trust bypass or production-server mutation.
rules.7: Baseline passed without app refresh fix; final rebuilt-input invocation is separate validation, not a rerun to hide failure.
rules.8: Named retained screenshots and exact XCTest identity; no credential/URL/body dump in helper failures.
rules.9: Exact configured case passed with0fail/skip/expected/runtimewarning; physical artwork, disk-hit provenance and unchanged-timestamp UI behavior remain separate.

rules.1: Select the installed usable runtime when a newer SDK has no available device.
rules.2: Native state/readiness markers are observed;no fixed sleep is treated as completion. Fixture policies use two second readiness/jq,five second build and one second cleanup budgets;the outer five second observation detects legacy non-return. Native owner polls actual state every10ms.
rules.3: N/A:no playback or media clock assertion.
rules.4: Production preparation has one synchronous owner and no boot worker thread/join. Owned native groups are retired on error/scope exit. Test FixtureWorker releases and joins on normal/unwind paths. No async-to-sync fallback.
rules.5: Fresh TempDir,atomic pid markers and invocation-specific commands/groups. No process-global PATH/env mutation,shared Simulator reset or service kill.
rules.6: Native macOS/Linux process boundary,not a simulated OS. m2 evidence only;no real xcrun/xcodebuild/Simulator or Linux execution claimed. Actual jq is required only by the original selection tests.
rules.7: Three legacy regressions were observed failing after minimal command extraction;their logs/source hashes are retained. Compile alias/lifetime and Clippy conditional-style corrections are retained. No budget or functional assertion widened to obtain a pass.
rules.8: Match stage/cause/native exit and cleanup fields. Primary operation plus peer/cleanup/capture errors remain distinct. Captured output Debug/Display expose lengths;UTF8 cause retains validation offsets without raw bytes.
rules.9: Final m2 owning suite147/147 across11nonempty targets;16zero-test CLI targets are build checks only. Fourteen selected identities each pass three exact focused runs(42/42). Source-epoch artifacts and final hashes are in .build/i371-runner-verification.json.
